villager-trade-helper.button.trade_all.t: Trade the selected offer over and over until the villager is out of stock, you run out of payment, or your inventory is full.
villager-trade-helper.button.trade_all.s: Or shift-click any offer in the list.
villager-trade-helper.tooltip.may_fill_u: Your inventory may fill up first.
villager-trade-helper.config.title: Villager Trade Helper
villager-trade-helper.config.show_button:
A button under the trade slots that trades the
selected offer until the villager or you run out.
villager-trade-helper.config.shift_click: Shift-click an offer to trade all

Shift-clicking an offer in the list trades it
until the villager or you run out.
Hold Shift over an offer to see what it would do.
villager-trade-helper.config.ticks_betwe:
1 is as fast as the game allows. Raise it if a
server's anti-cheat complains about fast clicking.
villager-trade-helper.config.chat_summar:
Also put "Traded 16 times: ..." in chat,
not only above the trade window.
villager-trade-helper.config.show_stock_:
A bar along the bottom of each offer showing
how much the villager has left, green to red.
villager-trade-helper.config.dim_unaffor: Dim offers you can't pay for
Darken offers you don't have the items for.
villager-trade-helper.config.remember_tr:
Save each villager's offers when you close its
trade screen, per world or server, to show them
when you look at that villager again.
villager-trade-helper.config.hud_mode.to:
Looking at a remembered villager lists its
offers next to the crosshair.
